categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches P2P label and modifies private broadcast connection tracking and net_processing logic in src/private_broadcast.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents a timing side channel in private broadcast where adversaries could infer origin or link connections by observing aborted outbound attempts. In P2P, privacy of transaction origin is a primary concern, and this patch fixes theoretical timing attacks noted in #34707 and #29415 by ensuring initial broadcast connections run to completion.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Changes to test runner and test files merely accompany the private broadcast behavioral change and do not modify test framework machinery.
categories.rationale: The functional and fuzz test changes are domain-specific tests for private broadcast rather than improvements to shared test infrastructure.
